steps.title: Definition
steps.guide: What is counted, in what unit, and which way is good.

fields.hint: Exactly what gets counted, so two people would get the same number.
What it is counted in. Pick one, or add a new one if nothing fits.

steps.title: Result
steps.guide: The aims this KPI tells you about, and where it sits in the results framework.

fields.hint: The aims this KPI tells you about, most often outcomes.

steps.title: Baseline and target
steps.guide: Where it stands today and where it needs to get to, each with its month.

fields.hint: The month that figure is from.
If today's figure is not known, why, and when it will be.
Where it needs to get to.
The month it is due by.

steps.title: Means of verification
steps.guide: Where the number is read from, and how often.

fields.hint: Which system or record this number is read from, so anyone can go and check it.
How often it is read. This sets the periods its readings are recorded for.

steps.title: Disaggregation
steps.guide: The segments this number is broken down by, if any.

fields.hint: How this number is broken down, such as by region. Leave empty if only the total is reported.
